description: Temporary, documented exceptions to GET = READ (CLAUDE.md §4.C). Each entry names the route, the tables it writes, why, and the master-plan PR that removes the write. The gate fails on any write not listed here and on any listed write that no longer happens, so this file only shrinks. The routes the harness cannot execute are baselined by identity: the gate fails if one is added (it would escape the gate) or one becomes executable again (remove it here). None of them is read-purity verified.
